evidence: Static committed baseline: solution/solve.sh only checks the source exists, refuses to reset an open database, then runs `rm -f -- "$target/app.db" "$target/app.db-wal" "$target/app.db-shm"` and `cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"`. It contains no npm, vite, curl, wget or git call, so nothing is built, installed or downloaded at install time; the prebuilt public/assets/index.js (1.9 MB, unminified) and index.css are committed. public/assets/index.css is byte-identical to src/style.css and public/runner.html to static/runner.html. Runtime needs only express and better-sqlite3, pinned identically in both images (environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile: `express@5.1.0`, `better-sqlite3@12.4.1`); package.json pins every dependency to an exact version and package-lock.json agrees. No boot-time fetch: server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3; the only fetch in src/app.tsx:12 is the same-origin API helper; the bundle contains no off-origin URL other than XML namespace and documentation strings; server.js:16 sends `default-src 'self'` and `connect-src 'self'`. Seeding is deterministic and empty: seed_data.json has `"snippets": []` and server.js creates empty tables only (the single INSERT OR IGNORE backfills revisions from existing rows). Ids are AUTOINCREMENT integers and revisions are counters (`revision = revision + 1`), not random. Nondeterministic sources exist but touch no pinned or graded value: `new Date().toISOString()` at server.js:71, 84, 111 fills updated_at/created_at, which no criterion, prompt or app_context line grades (search for timestamp/date/clock across tests/ and instructions found none) and which src/app.tsx does not render; `crypto.randomUUID()` in src/app.tsx:45, 85 and src/runtime.ts:27, 317, 318, 335, 386 produces console-entry keys, a restore operationId and preview message nonces, all opaque; the one `Date.now()` in the bundle is inside the bundled diff library's timeout option. The task defines no fixed clock and no graded rule uses time, so the skill's fixed-clock clause has nothing to apply to. Evidence files: all 13 script and result hashes I recomputed under qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict match raw-evidence-index.json; those results show every scripted criterion true with empty pageErrors, and restart.json shows the saved record at revision 2 with history [2, 1] after a real process restart. Notes, not defects: (1) the library list is ordered `updated_at DESC, id DESC` (server.js:65), a wall-clock order, but no criterion grades list position and id breaks ties; (2) the live library refresh polls every 2000 ms (src/app.tsx:138) against a ten-second criterion window, which is a fixed interval and not a pinned value; (3) I did not rebuild the bundle, so byte reproducibility of public/assets/index.js from src is unmeasured, and that does not matter here because solve.sh never rebuilds; distinctive literals from all three source files are present in the bundle; (4) I could not recompute the input SHA256 itself because the manifest algorithm is not stated in the assignment; (5) no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so judge-observed stability across runs is unmeasured.
